properties.name: Phase 1 of moving reflow2's design onto flo2.io: the copy CI reads, its one-PR guard, the recording path, the cut's step 6 and a break-glass note
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-10: "Merge 708, 710 and begin phase 1". The plan on dec:idea-reflow2s-own-design-moves-onto-flo2-io-or-stays-local names phase 1 as the copy script with the one-PR guard, AGENTS.md's recording path, the release-cut changes and a break-glass note, all before the move.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: tools/reflow2_design_copy.py (hold, copy, status) and its tests: 8 hermetic, 3 on the real binary, run in CI's full job. AGENTS.md now says how to record once the design is on flo2.io, what that choice costs, how the cut's step 6 changes, and how to work when flo2.io cannot serve the design. Nothing changes in practice until phase 2 moves the design.
